overview: DevKit Pro is a downloadable macOS app bundle designed for indie hackers and software engineers who want to skip boilerplate configuration. It combines a robust CLI with complete source code access to automate local development environments and streamline the app launch process.
usecases: Setting up a new development machine from scratch with a single command instead of manually installing dependencies
Automating repetitive deployment and release workflows before pushing to production
Inspecting, modifying, and extending the core source code to fit custom internal toolchains
howto: Download the app bundle and move it to your Applications folder
Run the built-in setup and doctor commands to configure your environment
Execute your first automated launch workflow via the CLI

faq.q: Is this just a wrapper around open-source scripts?
faq.a: No, it is a proprietary macOS app bundle combining a custom CLI and full source code designed specifically for end-to-end launch automation.

faq.q: Do I need an active internet connection to use the setup and doctor commands?
faq.a: An internet connection is required for the initial download and when installing external dependencies, but core diagnostics run locally.
